# Data Structures and Algorithms

## Dijkstra's Algorithm
Dijkstra's algorithm is an algorithm for finding the shortest paths between nodes in a weighted graph.

### Complexity
- Time Complexity: O((V + E) log V) with a binary min-heap.
- Space Complexity: O(V) for distances and visited set.

## Dynamic Programming
Dynamic programming solves problems by combining solutions to subproblems.
It applies when subproblems overlap and have optimal substructure.
